notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Crouching Pony Hidden Dragon
notes.content:
Crouching Pony Hidden Dragon is Now Available on Steam!

Crouching Pony Hidden Dragon is an Action/RPG type of game, totally novel and initially developed for SNK’s Neo-Geo console.

Under his false look of simple arcade game, CPHD hides a persistent world of rich and various rules, where « run’n gun » mechanics mix themselves with playful « RPG » ones.
